candidates.change_summary: Delete the if(msg.value >= MinDeposit) condition so Deposit updates balances for any amount.
Replace >= with < in the MinDeposit check so Deposit only updates balances for values strictly less than MinDeposit.
Remove the msg.value addition from the require overflow check, making it a tautology require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender] + msg.value)) allowing overflow.
Change balances update from += to = so balance is set to msg.value instead of adding.

Change the AddMessage call argument from msg.value to a constant 0 so the event is logged but balance update still occurs (the observable balance change is unaffected, this is not a balance-altering edit; not confident; removed).
Delete the balances update line, so Deposit only logs but does not change balances.

Change balance update to use msg.sender.balance or wrong account — not confident this is a single-statement edit so removed. Replacing balances[msg.sender] with balances[tx.origin] could change which balance is updated.
